name: meridian
description: Redis-backed job queue for Node.js with a Horizon-style supervisor and dashboard

scripts.build: npm run build -w @meridian/core && npm run build -w @meridian/supervisor && npm run build -w @meridian/dashboard
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test:chaos: docker compose --profile chaos up -d --wait redis-durable && CHAOS_REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:6390 vitest run packages/core/test/chaos
scripts.test:cluster: docker compose --profile cluster up -d --wait redis-cluster && REDIS_CLUSTER_NODES=127.0.0.1:7100,127.0.0.1:7101,127.0.0.1:7102 vitest run packages/*/test/cluster
